asset.name: Visual Recipes
asset.description: The typed variant system that maps component variants and states to tokenized styles and keeps arbitrary one-off visual values from spreading, exporting each recipe in a shape tools can enumerate.

requires.reason: A recipe resolves variant values to tokens; without the ramps there is nothing to resolve to.

rationale: The mechanism behind the exported-typed-variant-map decision: recipes are what make an asset's declared variants comparable against its implementation, and what lets story args be derived rather than hand-written.
